title: 1872 Hamada earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1872 Hamada earthquake", at revision 1314718531, opens: "The 1872 Hamada earthquake was an earthquake that occurred on March 14, 1872, off the coast of Hamada, Shimane Prefecture in Japan. This quake occurred at 16:40 local time." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11557942, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "earthquake in Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
